source: compiled from official school athletics sites (rosters/signing releases), si.com team sites, on3.com (non-paywalled), 5wins.com, big10central.com, dignittanyvolleyball.com, rockmnation, idsnews, yahoo sports, and volleytalk.proboards forums; cross-verified across sending/receiving teams where possible
confidence: Incoming (IN) transfers are the strongest dimension, mostly confirmed via official school roster/signing announcements. Outgoing (OUT) transfers are the weakest and likely INCOMPLETE for many teams, because most school sites publish additions but not departures, and several aggregator/forum/paywalled sources were blocked. Many multi-school moves were cross-verified from both sides. Treat empty OUT arrays as 'none verified,' not 'none exist.' Non-official, non-exhaustive tracker.

Kentucky.note: Sarafa was first reported at SMU (Dec 2025) but appears on UCLA's 2026 roster as an ex-Kentucky transfer. A 4th departure, Jordyn Dailey (to Pitt), was not a clear 2025 rotation player and is excluded.

Texas.note: partial. Ames was a two-year starting MB. Starting libero Emma Halter left but went pro (not portal). Whitney Lauenstein departed to Penn State (see Penn State IN). No incoming college transfers verified.

SMU.note: partial. IN well-sourced from official SMU releases. Could not verify a rotation player who LEFT SMU via portal (2025 departures Averi Carlson, Malaya Jones went pro). An early release listed Ava Sarafa incoming, but she did not enroll (replaced by Ellie Moore).

Nebraska.note: No rotation players entered the portal (second straight year). Only incoming transfer is OPP Allie Sczech from Baylor.

Wisconsin.note: Vajagic was the only 2025 starter to leave via portal. Starting MBs Booth and Andrew left via exhausted eligibility/graduation. Deep-bench portal exits (Horner->TCU, Shadd-Ceres->Creighton, Serafinowska->Arizona State) excluded as non-rotation.

Louisville.note: partial. Outgoing 2026 rotation departures could not be verified (a genuine gap, not confirmed empty). Bultema is borderline rotation (reduced 2025 role at Kentucky). Ava Utterback left for UCLA (see UCLA IN).

Pitt.note: Ryla Jones (MB) was a clear rotation player. Deep-bench portal exits Dalia Virlan (->Oregon) and Kiana Dinn (->South Carolina) excluded. Rachel Jepsen left to BYU.

Creighton.note: partial. No 2025 rotation player verified leaving Creighton via portal for 2026 (departures Wendlick/Strain redshirted or DNP in 2025). Destiny Ndam-Simpson left to Arizona.

Stanford.note: partial. No 2025 starter left via portal. Dunkle was a freshman reserve who redshirted in 2025 (borderline rotation). Seniors Rubin (pro) and Pringle exhausted eligibility. Wagner (S) is the only incoming college transfer.

Arizona State.note: partial. IN from ASU's 1/9/2026 announcement (5 transfers). Frame (Cincinnati) and Glover (Oregon) joined in 2025, excluded. OUT unverified: departed 2025 players were mostly graduating seniors; non-senior reserves off the roster could not be confirmed as portal entries.

Texas A&M.note: partial. 4 incoming transfers confirmed. Reporting cited one unnamed 2026 outgoing portal player that could not be verified; other departures (Lednicky, Cos-Okpalla, Waak) were graduating seniors/pro-bound. OUT left empty rather than guess.

Kansas.note: partial. Zelenovic (All-Big 12 First Team) and Dalton (senior setter) solid rotation; Leban and Papac borderline freshman key-subs. Papac destination filled via ASU's incoming list. Ellie Moore also left (to SMU). Hasbrook is the only incoming transfer.

TCU.note: partial. IN = Jan 2026 mid-year transfers per TCU Athletics (Mia Lee from BYU corroborated by BYU-side reporting; an unverified 'Reese Robins' prior-school entry was dropped). Coleman (2025 rotation freshman OH) destination filled via LSU's incoming list. Full outgoing list may be incomplete.

Miami.note: partial. IN = four new 2026 transfers per official roster. Bridges/Wiley/Arroyo were 2025-cycle arrivals, excluded. No 2026 outgoing portal moves reliably verified.

Penn State.note: partial. Starck, Burke, Willow confident rotation; Collins (true frosh) and Lally (Jr DS) plausible but unconfirmed. Willow/Lally destinations unknown. Graduating seniors excluded.

Florida.note: partial. New HC Ryan Theis had heavy turnover; OUT list likely incomplete. Stucky (starting S) and Auguste (2024 SEC Freshman of the Year) confirmed exits. McMillian left to TCU.

USC.note: partial. Etter (setter) confirmed via official USC announcement. No 2026 outgoing transfers verified. Roster is JS-only, so additional incoming transfers may exist unconfirmed.

Baylor.note: partial. Haggard (setter, 2025 Big East co-Freshman of the Year) confirmed IN. Sczech (OPP) departed to Nebraska. Other outgoing not verified; roster JS-only.

Purdue.note: partial. Mambu (OH) and Hansen (MB grad transfer) confirmed IN. Carr departed to Kentucky (see Kentucky IN). Key 2025 losses were mostly graduations.

Illinois.note: partial. Chapman (opposite) and Oldendorf (MB grad transfer) confirmed IN. Starostenko is an international pro signing, not a college transfer (excluded). No verified 2026 rotation portal departures.

Washington.note: partial. IN pair from secondary/paywalled reporting, not a primary source (treat as probable). No outgoing rotation transfers verified; gohuskies.com roster is JS-only and On Montlake article is subscriber-only. Weakest team in this dataset.

Missouri.note: Crownover (All-SEC setter) confirmed portal-out to Oregon (cross-verified). Harvey left to Miami (see Miami IN). Other veteran starters departed via graduation/exhausted eligibility.

UCLA.note: Reporting confirms UCLA had zero players enter the portal; 2025 departures were graduations. Brooklyn Briscoe left to Florida. Li/Singletary/Schumacher are 2025-cycle transfers, excluded.

Indiana.note: partial. Vinson (OH->Dayton) was a limited-role freshman (borderline rotation). Matheny left to Tennessee (see Tennessee IN). Kiki Granberry = Keondreya Granberry, cross-referenced with Tennessee's outgoing list.

Georgia Tech.note: partial. IN confirmed via official roster ('Transfer' label). Mambu left to Purdue. Stojanovic/Lopuyo are roster-diff inferences (destinations unverified, GT stats pages removed). Departed 2025 freshmen with unconfirmed rotation status excluded.

Michigan.note: partial. Michigan's four 2026 newcomers are all HS freshmen (no incoming college transfers). Simmons (R-Jr OH) is the only eligible 2025 player absent from the 2026 roster; destination and true rotation role unverified.

Arizona.note: partial. IN fully confirmed via official 2026 roster. Rotation status of Bridges/Mandotti not fully box-score-verified. Portal-out freshmen Thies and Giehtbrock excluded as non-rotation.

Tennessee.note: partial. Heavy turnover under HC Eve Rackham Watt. Humphrey->Georgia Tech, Granberry->Indiana, Chapman->Illinois destinations filled via cross-reference. Williams destination unpublished. Non-rotation portal-outs (Mogridge, Schnell, Stucky) excluded.

Oregon.note: partial. 4 incoming transfers confirmed; Crownover cross-verified with Missouri. Main 2025 rotation losses were graduations. No 2026-cycle rotation player confirmed leaving via portal.

BYU.note: partial. New HC (Neilson). Davis (Big 12 Freshman of the Year) confirmed out to SMU; Lee and Bobik out to TCU (cross-verified with TCU IN). Jepsen (returned missionary) likely depth. HS-freshman signees excluded.

LSU.note: Main 2025 starter losses (Nia Washington, Ana Tevdoradze) were graduations, not portal. Coleman in from TCU (cross-verified).

Utah.note: partial. Joki destination unconfirmed. Starters Emrie Moea'i and Leah Wilton-LaBoy graduated (not portal). Mogridge in from Tennessee.

Minnesota.note: No rotation portal departures verified; OH Julia Hanson left for pro (not a college transfer).

Iowa State.note: No confirmed portal departures; key 2025 losses (Duckworth, Brandt) were graduations.

Colorado.note: partial. Finley (starting setter) destination unconfirmed. New setter Jenna Ylivainio came from European pro (not college), excluded from IN.

San Diego.note: partial. University of San Diego (WCC). Clark->Indiana and Osunsanmi->Arizona cross-verified with those teams' IN lists (batch-4 labeled Clark 'Isabel'; Indiana lists 'Izzy Clark' - same player). Kitna destination unconfirmed. Starters Bennett, Engeman graduated.

Michigan State.note: OUT players were limited-role reserves (few/no starts), not full starters; actual starter Evie Doezema graduated. Hood->Georgia Tech cross-verified. Bankston was a bench player at Louisville.

North Carolina.note: No rotation-level transfer traffic in or out verified; only rotation loss (libero Maddy May) was a graduating senior, replaced by HS freshmen. Deep-bench Cadence Shea left via portal but excluded (4 sets in 2025).

UTEP.note: Sekita was starting libero; Massey/Imperial were backups (borderline rotation). Several starters (Weaver, Pustahija) graduated, not portal.

Western Kentucky.note: partial. Weihe (MB, had eligibility) presumed portal but destination unverified; key losses Bauer, Schaefer graduated. Roster 'last school' fields were misleading and manually filtered.
